# Pickwise Corporate Contributor License Agreement

*Version 1.0. Adapted from the Apache Software Foundation Software Grant and Corporate Contributor License Agreement.*

This Corporate Contributor License Agreement ("Agreement") lets a company or other organisation ("Corporation") authorise its employees to contribute to Pickwise (the "Project"), maintained by Srikar Yelamanchili (the "Maintainer"). Individuals contributing on the Corporation's behalf still sign the [Individual CLA](CLA.md) through the CLA Assistant bot on their pull request.

The Corporation accepts and agrees to the following terms for its present and future Contributions submitted to the Maintainer. Except for the licenses granted here, the Corporation keeps all right, title and interest in its Contributions.

## 1. Definitions

**"You" (or "Your")** means the Corporation making this Agreement, together with all entities that control, are controlled by, or are under common control with it. "Control" has the meaning given in the Individual CLA.

**"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including modifications or additions to an existing work, that is intentionally submitted by You, or by a Designated Employee, to the Maintainer for inclusion in, or documentation of, the Project, as defined in the Individual CLA.

**"Designated Employees"** means the employees and contractors listed in Schedule A, as updated in writing by You from time to time.

2. Each Contribution is either an original creation of a Designated Employee or is submitted under section 7.

Contact the Maintainer, [@srikary12](https://github.com/srikary12), through a private GitHub security advisory titled "Corporate CLA". You'll receive a signable copy. Once it's signed, the Designated Employees above can contribute; each still accepts the Individual CLA on their first pull request.
